/* TrackingOrderMapper.selectTrackingList */ SELECT tr.ENT_CODE ,tr.OD_JOB_NO ,tr.TRACKING_JOB_NO ,tr.HBL_NO ,OD.PO_NO ,OD.DELIVERY_NO ,tr.DELIVERY_CODE ,tr.POD_STATUS ,tr.POD_NAME ,tr.POD_DATE ,tr.POD_TIME ,tr.REMARKS ,tr.STATUS ,tr.ERROR_DESC ,tr.SEND_DATE_TIME ,tr.REGISTER_USER_ID ,tr.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,tr.UPDATE_USER_ID ,tr.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,CASE WHEN OD.BOUND = 'AIR' THEN 'T00017' ELSE 'T00025' END AS COURIER_CODE ,OD.BOUND ,OD.BOUND_TYPE ,OD.ORIG_COUNTRY ,OD.SHIPMENT_BOX_ID ,OD.RETURN_REQUEST_ID ,pod.DELIVERY_STORE_NAME AS BRANCH_NAME ,pod.COURIER_BRAN_TEL AS BRANCH_TEL ,pod.COURIER_NAME AS WORKER_NAME ,pod.COURIER_TEL AS WORKER_TEL ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(cii.CUSTOMS_ID_JOB_NO, '') != '' AND cii.STATUS IN ('02','03') THEN 'N' ELSE '' END AS CUSTOMS_CHK FROM TB_ECM_COUPANG_TRACKING tr INNER JOIN (SELECT OD.OD_JOB_NO ,OD.BOUND ,OD.BOUND_TYPE ,OD.CUST_CODE_LV2 ,MT.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED AS DELIVERY_NO ,OD.PO_NO ,OD.CD_TYPE ,OD.ORIG_COUNTRY ,AD.DROP_YN ,OD.SHIPMENT_BOX_ID ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(MT.OD_JOB_NO,'') = '' THEN AD.RETURN_REQUEST_ID ELSE MT.RETURN_REQUEST_ID END AS RETURN_REQUEST_ID FROM TB_ECM_OD OD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL AD ON AD.OD_JOB_NO = OD.OD_JOB_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI MT ON MT.OD_JOB_NO = OD.OD_JOB_NO) OD ON OD.OD_JOB_NO = tr.OD_JOB_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, POD_STATUS, DELIVERY_STORE_NAME, COURIER_BRAN_TEL, COURIER_NAME, COURIER_TEL FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, BL_NO, POD_STATUS, DELIVERY_STORE_NAME, COURIER_BRAN_TEL, COURIER_NAME, COURIER_TEL FROM TB_ECM_POD_04_M ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = tr.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.BL_NO = tr.HBL_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = tr.POD_STATUS LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_CUSTOMS_ID_INFO cii ON cii.HBL_NO = tr.HBL_NO AND cii.INPUT_METHOD = 'COUPANG' WHERE tr.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND tr.STATUS = 'R'
AND ((tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM240', 'ECM210') AND OD.CD_TYPE = 'Y') OR (tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM250','ECM280') AND (OD.CD_TYPE IN ('N', 'B') OR OD.DROP_YN = 'Y')) OR tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM010','ECM065'))
AND tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM361','ECM370','ECM380','ECM390','ECM400','ECM420','ECM500','ECM510','ECM520','ECM530','ECM540','ECM550')
AND ((tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM240', 'ECM210') AND OD.CD_TYPE = 'Y') OR (tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM250','ECM280') AND (OD.CD_TYPE IN ('N', 'B') OR OD.DROP_YN = 'Y')) OR tr.POD_STATUS IN ('ECM010','ECM065','ECM361','ECM370','ECM380','ECM390','ECM400','ECM420','ECM510','ECM520','ECM530','ECM540','ECM550'))
AND tr.HBL_NO IN (#{item})
ORDER BY tr.OD_JOB_NO, tr.POD_STATUS, tr.POD_DATE, tr.POD_TIME

SELECT ENT_CODE , DELIVERY_CODE , RECV_API_URL , RECV_API_CODE , RECV_API_ID , RECV_API_PW , TRACKING_API_URL FROM TB_SMS_DELIVERY_API_INFO WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND DELIVERY_CODE = #{deliveryCode}
